height_interpolation.input_coordinates: two signed16 words; low bytes are unsigned fractions; high coordinates wrap with mask127
height_interpolation.output: signed32 doubled height; arithmetic shift7, diagonal fx<fy

terrain_vertex.note: Do not replace with (2*height)>>6; original terrain-vertex rounding differs from arbitrary-point projection.

limits: Map record bytes beyond height/texture/orientation remain opaque; signed16 at0 and byte12 feed lighting but are not assigned gameplay names.
Mode5 samples stride256 and maps every source index through FADE.DAT; zero is not skipped.
Initial camera origin, live shade/visibility fields, full triangle rasterization/clipping and overlay composition are not implemented by this receipt.
Atlas pointer160 is one past source allocation; safe API rejects160+ rather than accepting the startup sentinel.
Height scale and steps are constructor facts, not proof of a selected camera position or a whole original terrain frame.
